hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
# Stop hook: enforce merge-main -> push -> PR workflow before ending a session
# on a non-default branch that has actual work on it.
repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0
cd "$repo_root" || exit 0

default_branch=$(git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's@^refs/remotes/origin/@@')
if [ -z "$default_branch" ]; then
  if git rev-parse --verify -q origin/main >/dev/null; then
    default_branch=main
  elif git rev-parse --verify -q origin/master >/dev/null; then
    default_branch=master
  else
    exit 0
  fi
fi

current_branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null)
if [ -z "$current_branch" ] || [ "$current_branch" = "$default_branch" ] || [ "$current_branch" = "HEAD" ]; then
  exit 0
fi

dirty=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)

has_upstream=0
ahead=0
if git rev-parse --verify -q "origin/$current_branch" >/dev/null; then
  has_upstream=1
  ahead=$(git rev-list --count "origin/$current_branch..HEAD" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
fi

# Only enforce if this branch actually has work on it: uncommitted changes,
# or commits that diverge from the default branch.
commits_ahead_of_default=0
if git rev-parse --verify -q "origin/$default_branch" >/dev/null; then
  commits_ahead_of_default=$(git rev-list --count "origin/$default_branch..HEAD" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
fi

if [ -z "$dirty" ] && [ "$commits_ahead_of_default" = "0" ]; then
  exit 0
fi

merged_main=1
if git rev-parse --verify -q "origin/$default_branch" >/dev/null; then
  if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "origin/$default_branch" HEAD 2>/dev/null; then
    merged_main=0
  fi
fi

problems=""
[ -n "$dirty" ] && problems="$problems uncommitted local changes;"
[ "$has_upstream" = "0" ] && problems="$problems branch '$current_branch' has never been pushed to origin;"
[ "$has_upstream" = "1" ] && [ "$ahead" != "0" ] && problems="$problems $ahead local commit(s) not yet pushed;"
[ "$merged_main" = "0" ] && problems="$problems origin/$default_branch has not been merged into this branch yet;"

if [ -z "$problems" ]; then
  exit 0
fi

reason="End-of-session workflow is not finished on branch '$current_branch':$problems Before ending this session: (1) merge $default_branch into this branch and resolve any conflicts, (2) commit and push, (3) open a pull request if one is not already open for this branch, and (4) subscribe to PR activity and address any CI failures now visible. Do not end the turn until this is done, or until you have a concrete blocker to report."
escaped=$(printf '%s' "$reason" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.dumps(sys.stdin.read()))' 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$reason" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g')
printf '{"decision":"block","reason":%s}\n' "$escaped"
exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: Checking session-end workflow (merge main / push / PR)...
